newsitem.title: JAPAN: Rikadenki ask-only after trade suspension.
newsitem.headline: Rikadenki ask-only after trade suspension.

text.p: Rikadenki Kogyo Co Ltd shares were ask-only in early Thursday trade after being suspended from over-the-counter trade on Wednesday afternoon, brokers said.
As of 0038 GMT, the shares of the measurement instrument manufacturer were ask-only at 355 yen, after last being traded at 365 yen on Wednesday.

Late on Wednesday, the company said in a statement that it had a problem in honouring promissory notes for the first time earlier this month, but added that it could avoid any repetition of such a problem for now.

Rikadenki, which makes various measurement instruments, said the problem occurred after the company put an incorrect payment date on its promissory notes and that it completed payments on February 24.
It said it currently holds debts worth 1.51 billion yen and that it would be able to avoid a repetition of such problems this month.
